section: 1e N=1 beta functions in DRED (Wess-Zumino model)
authors: L.V. Avdeev, S.G. Gorishny, A.Yu. Kamenshchik, S.A. Larin
title: Four-loop beta function in the Wess-Zumino model
claim: Four-loop beta-function of the Wess-Zumino model (supersedes the earlier four-loop result of Sen-Sundaresan, Phys. Lett. B101 (1981) 61, which later literature cites separately).
theory: Wess-Zumino model (single chiral superfield, cubic superpotential)
scheme: Superspace with dimensional continuation of momentum integrals (supersymmetric DR / DRED type) - not verified from the paper itself.
symmetry_argument: Superspace non-renormalization: beta = 3 g gamma_Phi (Z_g Z_Phi^{3/2} = 1).

checked_partially: Four-loop result re-verified by Gracey with MINCER/FORCER (S1e.14_Gracey2021, if ref. [6] there is this paper - not confirmed).

evidence: Bibliographic record only (Scilit/DOI); no abstract or text accessed.
red_flags: Paper not accessed; scheme and details unverified.
cross_checks: Generalized four-loop WZ results reproduce it (hep-ph/9610296 per search snippet; hep-th/9712138 large-N).
